title: Quotations
description: Price the estimate of each panel with a margin, a discount and VAT, and keep every version of the quotation
searchPlaceholder: Search quotation no., request code or title...
noneYet: This request has no quotation yet.
olderVersion: This is an older version, view only.
readOnlyStatus: This version is "{status}" and cannot be edited.
readOnlyNoRights: You can only view this quotation.

pricing.hint: Figures shown while typing are for reference; the system calculates and stores them when you save. A percent discount is at most {max}.

validation.discountPercentInvalid: A percent discount is a number from 0 to 100 with at most 2 decimals.
validation.discountInvalid: A discount amount is a number of at least 0 with at most 2 decimals.
validation.discountTooLarge: The discount cannot exceed the subtotal.

toast.readOnly: This version cannot be edited; only a draft can.
toast.alreadyExists: This request already has a quotation.
toast.noEstimate: The estimate of this request has not been priced yet, so it cannot be quoted.
toast.staleRevision: The estimate has a newer submitted revision; reload and try again.
toast.requestState: The request's current status does not allow a quotation.
toast.discountTooLarge: The discount cannot exceed the subtotal.
toast.amountTooLarge: The value exceeds the allowed limit.
toast.systemError: Something went wrong, please try again later.
toast.forbidden: You do not have permission to do this.
toast.refreshDiscountTooLarge: The fixed discount would exceed the updated subtotal; lower the discount first, then update again.
toast.staleEstimate: The estimate was revised; update the quotation from the latest estimate and submit again.
toast.versionState: The version's current status does not allow this.
toast.changedMeanwhile: Someone else just changed the version; reload and try again.
toast.requestCannotMove: The request's current status does not allow this.

approval.title: Approval and follow-up

hint.draft: Draft: adjust margins, discount, VAT and terms, then submit for approval.
hint.pending_approval: Waiting for an approver other than the version's creator to decide.
hint.approved: Approved: download the customer file, record feedback, and confirm when the customer accepts.
hint.rejected: Rejected: revise it into a new version to fix it.
hint.customer_confirmed: The customer has confirmed this quotation.
hint.cancelled: The quotation is cancelled and the request is marked lost.
hint.closed: This version is closed; a newer version replaced it.

approval.stale: The estimate has a newer submitted revision than this draft uses. Update from the latest estimate before submitting.
approval.creatorCannotDecide: You created this version or last edited its price or terms, so someone else must approve or reject it.
approval.submitBlockedStale: Update from the latest estimate before submitting
approval.unsaved: The prices or terms have unsaved changes. Save them before submitting, or the quotation goes in with the stored figures.
approval.submitBlockedUnsaved: Save the price and terms changes before submitting
approval.submitDescription: Once submitted, the quotation waits for an approver and you cannot edit this version's prices or terms.
approval.approveDescription: This version is approved to go to the customer. Changing it later means opening a new version.
approval.rejectDescription: This version is kept as it is; the salesperson will open a new version to fix it.
approval.cancelDescription: The quotation ends and the request is recorded as lost. A returning customer needs a new request.

reason.max: The reason can be at most {max} characters.
